# Record and publish limit changes

As a support agent I want every limit change recorded and announced so that reports and audits see it.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given an account with a limit of 1000, when support changes it to 500, then a limit_change row records the old and the new limit and limits.changed is published.

## Links

- Record ledger-db.limit-change: new table limit_change (id bigint, account_id bigint, old_limit numeric(18,2), new_limit numeric(18,2), changed_by_email varchar(200), changed_at timestamp) (data.md:8)
- Interface new: ledger-api → reports-job publish limits.changed (planned-new, interfaces.md:10)
